title: BSPA: Exploring Black-box Stealthy Prompt Attacks against Image Generators

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the word frequency distribution (word cloud) of the generated stealthy prompts and conducting a qualitative case study on the resulting toxic images to observe disproportionate representation (e.g., female-focused NSFW terms).
Conducting a detailed qualitative case study of the toxic prompts and generated images to identify pronounced racial disparities reflecting biases present in the training data.
